name: Run each query twice and union the pages
when: every paid Scholar query — Scholar's index view varies between requests and a single page can be a degraded view
shape: the same q twice (the second with a forced refresh), results united by cluster id; keep probing while the view is tiny
ingredients: a transport that can force a fresh page
yields: works the first page omitted; a healthy view after ≥2 probes with ≥10 rows
misses: nothing new when the index is stable — the second probe then costs one page for no gain
origin: the Referee's url-works and secondary-works probe loops
